title: Substitute
text: Let $$x=tan(\theta)$$. Then the integral becomes the integral of $$\operatorname{csc}\left(\theta\right) \operatorname{cot}\left(\theta\right)$$ with respect to θ.

title: Integrate and convert back
text: The integral is $$-csc(\theta)$$, and csc(θ) is $$\frac{\sqrt{1+x^2}}{x}$$.
